firm_data.firm_description: Drake Loeb PLLC is a prominent, mid-sized law firm located in the Hudson Valley. The firm is distinguished as a leader in providing legal representation on a broad range of areas to individuals, businesses, non-profit organizations, insurance carriers and municipalities.

email.subject: AI for Drake Loeb PLLC, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Jennifer,

Your AV-preeminent Martindale-Hubbell rating speaks to the caliber of work Drake Loeb delivers across the Hudson Valley. That reputation is exactly what made me want to reach out.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the Hudson Valley region to meet with firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with larger competitors.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
